summary.desc: A claw from a fanged demon with two massive horns.

raw.name: Demon Claw

dictionary.lore: A claw from a beast named after a creature from another world which shares its name with common demons because of their similar horns. One theory states that that this beast is from a subspecies of intelligent dragons who appear to enchant their own claws with a special kind of magic. Assuming one is powerful enough to access Amdahl, they are relatively easy to find in the area.
